author: Jaydaddy
description:
You're in a John Wick movie | (John Wick Parody, John Wick Short Film)

Original Score by: @JacobLizotte 
Official Soundtrack: https://youtu.be/OepPmmlrjy8

A retired hitman is forced back into the underworld in this John Wick parody, packed with high-intensity action, gun fights, hand-to-hand combat, and cinematic fight scenes. When his dog is killed, it ignites a relentless chain of events, pushing him back into a world of assassins where survival means eliminating anyone in his path. The Baba Yaga.

Inspired by: 
John Wick 1 (2014)
John Wick: Chapter 2 (2017)
John Wick: Chapter 3 - Parabellum (2019)
John Wick: Chapter 4 (2023)
The Continental: From the World of John Wick (2023)
From the World of John Wick: Ballerina (2025)
Wick Is Pain (2025)
